mapper.select: select workbench_id, user_id, project_id, config_json, create_time, update_time from sys_user_workbench where user_id = #{userId} and project_id = #{projectId} limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into sys_user_workbench (user_id, project_id, config_json, create_time, update_time) values (#{userId}, #{projectId}, #{configJson}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
